title: The Local Four-Square Problem over \(\mathbb{Z}_{p^k}\)
summary: The norm map \(N:\mathcal{H}_{\mathbb{Z}_{p^k}}\to \mathbb{Z}_{p^k}\) is studied on the quaternion ring over \(\mathbb{Z}_{p^k}\), where \(p\) is an odd prime and $k\ge 1$ an integer. By means of the isomorphism \(\mathcal{H}_{\mathbb{Z}_{p^k}}\cong M_2(\mathbb{Z}_{p^k})\), quaternions are investigated using matrix methods. It is shown that the fibre size \[ a_{p^k}(m)=|\{q\in \mathcal{H}_{\mathbb{Z}_{p^k}}:N(q)=m\}| \] depends only on the \(p\)-adic valuation \(v_p(m)\) of \(m\).
